title: Thoson Relay™
body_html:
Your child presses a lever and the car pops up and sticks to the helicopter. They turn a crank and another one climbs the slope. They rotate a handle and the turntable spins the next car toward the bridge. Nothing on this track moves on its own.

That is the whole idea. Most car toys have a button that makes something happen while your child sits and watches, and then they need new batteries. Relay has no motor and no battery compartment at all. Press, crank, rotate. Every station asks something different of their hands, and if they stop, the track stops.

Includes the tabletop track and six mini cars, with a crane, a bridge, a turntable, a conveyor slope, a magnetic helicopter and an elevator platform. About ten inches square, so it sits on a kitchen table and goes back in the box when you need the table. Recommended for ages 3 and up. Contains small parts including the mini cars, so please keep away from children under 3 and supervise play.

title: Thoson Vortex™
body_html:
Lay the rope in a circle on any table. Split the pieces, ten each. Take turns dropping one inside the circle, and if yours snaps onto pieces already sitting there, you pick all of them up and add them to your pile. First player to run out wins. That is the entire game, and you just learned it.

Most family games die in the explanation. Somebody reads the booklet out loud, two people drift off, and the box goes back in the cupboard. Vortex takes about ten seconds to teach. And because the magnets behave the way they want, careful aim only helps so much, so a child beats an adult regularly and nobody has to let them win.

Includes twenty magnetic pieces, one game rope and a drawstring carry bag that fits in a coat pocket. No batteries, no board and nothing to set up. The box lists one to four players. Recommended for ages 8 and up. Contains small parts and strong magnets: swallowed magnets can cause serious internal injury, so keep away from younger children and pets, store the set in its bag, and supervise play.

title: Thoson Gift Card
body_html:
The toy that ends up at the back of the closet is usually the one somebody guessed at.

A Thoson gift card skips the guessing. They pick the set they actually want, and you're still the one who sent it.

  • In their inbox in minutes. Or on the morning you choose, up to 90 days out.
  • Your message rides along, so they know exactly who to thank.
  • No expiry, no fees. Spend it tonight or on a birthday two years from now.
  • Nothing gets wasted. Whatever's left stays on the card.

No box, no wrapping paper. What you get instead is a kid who chooses their own thing and actually plays with it.

title: Thoson Squishy Advent™
body_html:
Starting the first of December, your child opens one numbered door before school and pulls out a soft little dumpling character in a Santa hat or a set of antlers. A chocolate calendar is gone thirty seconds after the door opens, and by the tenth it is just sugar on an empty stomach. This one leaves something behind every single morning.

All twenty four are different, with no repeats and no filler days, so the one on the nineteenth is as interesting as the one on the second. They are made to be squeezed, which is why they do not stay in the box: they end up in coat pockets on the way to school, next to the homework, and in a hand on a long drive. The calendar is the December part. The characters are the rest of the year.

title: Thoson Run™
body_html:
Load a stack of tiles into one of the two trays, clip it onto the train and push the green switch. The train drives forward and sets the tiles down in a spaced row behind it, which is the one part of building a domino run that small hands cannot do. Your child decides where the row goes, and when it is ready, taps the first tile and the whole thing falls.

The red switch flips the train's direction, so a row can turn a corner instead of only running straight, and the cactus spinner drops into the middle of a row to throw the reaction off sideways. Two loading trays mean the second one gets filled while the first is still running, so the row keeps growing across the room instead of stopping every twenty tiles. With the train switched off, the 200 tiles are simply building blocks: towers, letters, numbers, whatever your child is picturing.

Includes the train with lights and sound effects, 200 ABS tiles in three colors, two loading trays and one cactus spinner. It needs a hard flat surface to lay a clean row, so wood, tile or a table top rather than carpet. Takes two AA batteries that are not included, so grab a set before a birthday or a holiday morning. Recommended for ages 4 and up. Contains 200 small tiles, so please keep away from children under 4 and supervise play.

title: Thoson Blitz™
body_html:
Bubbles light up at random and your child has to press them down before the timer runs out. Clear the round, flip it over, push the raised cover on the back, and the next level starts faster than the last one.

Hit the mode switch and the game changes completely. Now the lights show a pattern and they have to press it back in the right order, one longer every round. And unlike most light-up toys in this category, there is a sound button on the front, so you can turn it down in the car, off at the restaurant, or all the way up in the backyard without stopping the game.

Choose Blue Cat, Pink Rabbit or Yellow Deer. The body is ABS with soft silicone bubbles, sized to sit in one hand and wipe clean. Batteries are not included, so pick up a set before a birthday or a trip. Contains small parts and a battery compartment, so keep it away from children who still put things in their mouths, and supervise play.

title: Thoson Apex™
body_html:
Press one button and a T-Rex walks out across the floor, head swinging and claws reaching, roaring loud enough to make the dog leave the room. Press another and a cloud of cool mist rolls out of it while seven LED colors light that cloud up red, then blue, then green.

Apex walks forward, turns where your child steers it, roars, plays music and breathes on command. There is no app and nothing to pair, so most kids have the whole controller figured out in the first two minutes and never hand it back. Four things to do instead of one is the reason it is still in the middle of the living room floor a month later instead of at the bottom of the toy bin.

Includes the remote control T-Rex and its remote. Fill the built-in tank with plain water for the mist. Batteries for the dinosaur and the remote are not included, so pick up a set before a birthday or a Christmas morning. Recommended for ages 3 and up. Contains small parts, so please keep away from children under 3 and supervise play.

title: Thoson Clash™
body_html:
Two snakes, two remotes, one floor. Clash is a duel that starts the second the box opens, with no turns to take, no timer to set and no adult refereeing who goes next.

The magnetic blocks are the food. Every block a snake swallows locks onto its tail and makes it longer, so you can see who is winning from across the room. The heads light up and react while the chase is on, and both snakes charge over USB, so there are no batteries to hunt for.

Includes 2 remote control snakes in yellow and green, 2 remotes, 16 magnetic blocks and 2 USB charging cables. Recommended for ages 6 and up. Contains small parts and magnets: swallowed magnets can cause serious internal injury, so keep away from younger children and supervise play.

title: Thoson Quarry™
body_html:
A working quarry, not another parked truck. Kids build the route, load rocks at the loading station, run the conveyor, and send the motorized dump truck hauling its load around the track they designed a complete construction site that actually works, powered by their hands instead of a screen.

The motorized chassis swaps between machines to keep the site running, and the track rebuilds into new layouts, so every session becomes a new job to plan. Loading, hauling and dumping cycles teach cause-and-effect and planning through hands-on, screen-free play.

Includes the motorized dump truck, loading station with working conveyor, rock pieces and a customizable track set. Recommended for builders ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson Chime™
body_html:
The toy that calms the room. Chime is a solid-wood marble tree: drop a marble at the top and it cascades down rainbow leaves with a soft, musical ding.

Mesmerizing to watch, soothing to hear, and beautiful enough to live on the shelf — no batteries, no volume knob, no screen. A favorite for wind-down time.

Includes the solid wood marble tree and its marbles. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson Pippo™
body_html:
Meet Pippo, the talking puppy that turns pointing into words. Toddlers tap a card, Pippo says the word in a clear, real voice, and the repeat button plays it again as many times as they need.

73 cards of first words make vocabulary practice feel like playing with a pet — screen-free language learning toddlers can drive themselves.

Includes Pippo and 73 word cards. Recommended for ages 2 and up.

title: Thoson ReadLadder™
body_html:
From first sounds to full sentences, one rung at a time. ReadLadder is a teacher-made set of learn-to-read cards organized into 20 leveled stages.

Kids climb at their own pace — mastering sounds, then words, then sentences — with wins frequent enough to keep confidence high and eye-rolls low. Screen-free reading practice that sticks.

Includes the complete 20-stage card set. Recommended for ages 4–8.

title: Thoson 100,000 Whys™
body_html:
For the kid who asks "why" 400 times a day — finally, a book that keeps up. 100,000 Whys answers the questions kids actually ask across 6 science themes: astronomy, geography, technology, plants, animals and the human body.

Comic illustrations on every page turn complex ideas into pictures kids read past bedtime — ad-free, screen-free, curated content. It reads like fun, not homework, growing from simple facts to deeper "why" chains.

Recommended for curious kids ages 6–12.

title: Thoson Sandlab™
body_html:
The sensory bin that cleans itself up. Sandlab packs moldable sand and glow-in-the-dark stones into a bin that snaps shut in seconds — indoor sand play without the indoor sand problem.

Squeezing, shaping and burying treasure builds focus and calm through rich sensory play; the glow stones turn lights-off time into a treasure hunt.

Includes the snap-shut bin, moldable sand and glow stones. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson PixelForge™
body_html:
Pixel art, made of wood and magnets. PixelForge gives kids 288 magnetic pieces and a display board to snap together pictures, patterns and scenes — one satisfying click at a time.

A 162-page book with 280+ designs offers endless projects to copy or remix, building concentration, fine motor precision and creative confidence along the way.

Includes 288 magnetic wooden pieces, the display board and the design book. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson ShapeCrew™
body_html:
One hundred twenty shapes, endless pictures. ShapeCrew is a wooden pattern puzzle where kids rebuild colorful designs — or invent their own — on a wooden frame board.

Following the pattern cards trains shape recognition, spatial reasoning and focus; free-building trains imagination. Both happen without a screen in sight.

Includes 120 wooden shapes, 40 pattern cards and the frame board. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson LetterCrew™
body_html:
The alphabet, out of the book and into their hands. LetterCrew pairs 52 wooden letter blocks with 28 picture cards: kids pick a card, sound out the word, and spell it with real letters.

Matching, sounding and spelling builds phonics and letter recognition the hands-on way — screen-free practice that feels like play.

Includes 52 wooden letters and 28 picture cards. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson SkyPop™
body_html:
Push the button, flood the yard with bubbles. SkyPop is an outdoor bubble machine on an adjustable tower (28–47 in) with LED lights and music that turns any backyard into a chase scene.

Kids run, jump and pop while SkyPop keeps the bubbles coming — USB-C rechargeable with a fillable base, ready for parties, park days and everyday golden hour.

Includes the bubble tower machine with fillable base. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson FracSnap™
body_html:
Fractions kids can hold. FracSnap is a magnetic fraction book with 102 color-coded pieces — circles and bars from ½ down to 1/12 — that snap into place so math finally makes visual sense.

Kids see that two quarters equal a half by building it, turning the most abstract topic in elementary math into hands-on play. No screens, no apps, no tears.

Includes the magnetic book and 102 fraction pieces. Recommended for ages 4–10.

title: Thoson BuildBox™
body_html:
A real workshop, sized for small hands. BuildBox puts working kid-scale tools — drill, wrench, bolts — into little builders' hands and lets them actually build.

Projects come together, come apart and become something new, while the toolbox itself converts into a workbench and seat. No apps, no batteries — just proud little builders.

Includes the tool set, bolts and the convertible toolbox workbench. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson Lingo™
body_html:
Forty little books, one big milestone: reading on their own. Lingo is a set of 40 Read & Rhyme phonics flip books where kids physically flip letters to build words.

Word families, CVC words, short and long vowels, Magic E, digraphs and blends — every flip is hands-on phonics practice that turns sounding-out into a game.

Includes all 40 phonics flip books. Recommended for early readers ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson SquishBlocks™
body_html:
Building blocks that squish back. SquishBlocks are soft, satisfying blocks kids can stack, squeeze and connect — construction play and sensory play in one.

The gentle texture is perfect for little hands (and quiet-time focus), while stacking and building supports calm, imaginative, screen-free play.

Includes the full set of soft connecting blocks. Loved by toddlers and preschoolers.

title: Thoson Spark™
body_html:
Their first circuit, their first "it works!" Spark is an electronic logic board where kids snap in function modules to solve real puzzles with real electricity.

With 5 function modules and 500+ puzzle combinations, challenges scale from first connections at age 5 to genuine logic problems at age 10 — teaching circuits, sequencing and problem-solving as kids grow. USB rechargeable and fully screen-free.

Includes the Spark logic board and 5 snap-in modules. Recommended for ages 5–10.

title: Thoson WordPlay™
body_html:
Spelling practice they mistake for a game. WordPlay turns letters into playing pieces kids combine, swap and race to build into real words.

Each round grows vocabulary, spelling and early reading skills — the kind of practice that happens voluntarily, without screens or flashcard drills.

The Complete Learning Set includes everything needed to play. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson SnapTalk Duo™
body_html:
Their first phone call — without a phone. SnapTalk Duo is a pair of kid-sized video walkie-talkies with real two-way audio and video between handsets.

Secret missions across the house, check-ins from the backyard, sibling headquarters under the bunk bed: SnapTalk keeps kids connected and moving — no phone, no apps, no internet.

Includes 2 rechargeable video walkie-talkie handsets. Recommended for ages 5 and up.

title: MagTrack™ Extra Train
body_html:
Double the traffic on the MagTrack line. This extra USB-rechargeable train lets siblings run routes together — or lets one ambitious engineer manage a two-train timetable.

Same snap-on magnetic compatibility, same rechargeable design, twice the movement on every layout. Designed exclusively for the Thoson MagTrack system.

title: Thoson MagTrack™
body_html:
The train set kids engineer themselves. MagTrack's modular magnetic tracks snap together into loops, bridges and brand-new routes — then the motorized train takes the maiden run.

Design, test, fix, rebuild: every layout is a small engineering project that builds spatial reasoning and planning through hands-on STEM play. USB-rechargeable train, no screens anywhere.

Includes the motorized train and expandable magnetic track pieces. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson MicroScope Explorer™
body_html:
The hidden world, suddenly visible. The MicroScope Explorer gives kids a real look at leaves, bugs, fabric and everything else they can get under the lens.

Every specimen becomes a question, and every question becomes screen-free science — sized and simplified so young scientists can explore on their own.

Includes the kids' microscope and exploration accessories. Recommended for ages 5 and up — a back-to-school favorite.

title: Thoson SpiderRacer Duo™
body_html:
Two cars. Two remotes. One living-room championship. SpiderRacer Duo is a pair of remote-control stunt cars built for head-to-head racing.

Flips, spins and gravity-defying tricks keep siblings and friends competing lap after lap — active play that gets kids off the couch and into the race, with easy controls for beginners.

Includes 2 RC stunt cars and 2 controllers. Recommended for ages 5 and up.

title: TurboMonster Pack
body_html:
Built to be crashed. TurboMonster trucks are chunky, rugged monster trucks that survive exactly the kind of play energetic kids dish out.

Push them, race them, launch them off the couch — big wheels and tough bodies keep rolling through living-room rallies and backyard expeditions alike. Active, imaginative, screen-free play.

Includes the TurboMonster truck pack. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson AquaDoodle Book™
body_html:
A drawing book that never runs out. Kids doodle with just water — lines appear like magic, dry clear, and the page is ready to draw all over again.

No ink, no markers, no mess: perfect for car rides, restaurants and quiet time. Toddlers build pen control and creativity while the seats stay clean.

Includes the reusable AquaDoodle book with its water pen. A travel-bag essential for little artists.

title: Thoson Magic Gel™
body_html:
Pour, dip, and watch it become a dinosaur. Magic Gel is a water-activated craft kit where liquid color firms up in minutes into squishy 3D creatures kids made themselves.

Molding, squeezing and creating builds fine motor skills and patience — with a non-toxic formula and a quick-rinse reset that keeps the mess in the bin, not on the table.

The Full Pack includes 30 pieces with molds and precision tips. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson Lizard - Play Pack™
body_html:
It climbs the wall. Actually climbs the wall. The Thoson Lizard is a remote-control gecko that scurries up walls, windows and ceilings — and sends kids running after it.

Easy controls sized for small hands make it a first RC toy kids master fast, trading couch time for laps around the living room. USB rechargeable, so the chase never waits on batteries.

Includes the wall-climbing gecko and its remote control; charges over USB. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Thoson Blocks - Full Pack™
body_html:
Castles, spaceships, animal kingdoms — then it all comes apart and becomes something new. Thoson Blocks are magnetic building blocks that snap together into real 3D structures.

Kids plan, build, knock down and rebuild, developing spatial reasoning and engineering thinking through open-ended construction. No instructions required, no screens involved.

The Full Pack includes the complete set of magnetic blocks. Loved by builders from toddlers to big kids.

title: Count Crew - Full Pack™
body_html:
Math that lives in their hands, not on a screen. Count Crew turns numbers into things kids can hold, sort, stack and count.

Through play, kids practice counting, number recognition and early adding — building real number confidence one game at a time. No worksheets, no drills, no screens.

The Full Pack includes the complete hands-on counting set. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

title: Spell & Play - Full Pack™
body_html:
The moment letters stop being abstract: kids build real words with their own hands. Spell & Play turns spelling practice into a game young readers actually ask to play.

Pick a word, find the letters, snap them into place — each round builds letter recognition, phonics and early reading confidence without a single worksheet or screen.

The Full Pack includes the complete word-building set. Recommended for ages 5 and up.

title: NestWood - Full Pack™
body_html:
Forty-two wooden Tetris-style blocks, one deceptively simple challenge: make them fit. NestWood turns spatial reasoning into hands-on play kids come back to again and again.

Start with easy fits and work up through progressive challenges — rotating, flipping and planning until every piece clicks into place. Open-ended, Montessori-inspired and completely screen-free.

Includes 42 durable wooden blocks in a rainbow of shapes. A quiet-time favorite for toddlers and preschoolers.

title: 12-Color Marker Refill Pack - Thoson Bot
body_html:
Fresh colors for the hardest-working robot in the house. This refill pack brings 12 bright, washable markers sized for the Thoson Bot drawing robot.

Smooth ink keeps every guided drawing crisp, and the washable formula wipes off skin and most surfaces, so kids can color the Bot's creations worry-free. Compatible with all Thoson Bot sets.

title: Magic Art - 50 Sheets
body_html:
Keep the little studio stocked. This refill pack adds 50 sheets of the special Magic Art paper that reacts only to the Magic Art brush — no ink, no stains, no mess.

Swap in a fresh sheet and kids keep creating: same mess-free magic, 50 more masterpieces. Designed exclusively for the Thoson Magic Art set.

title: Magic Art - Full Pack™
body_html:
All the painting, none of the mess. Magic Art pairs special reactive paper with an interactive brush, so color appears only on the page — never on hands, walls or the sofa.

Kids color and paint independently at home or on the road while parents skip the cleanup. Every finished sheet builds creativity, focus and pride, completely screen-free.

The Full Pack includes the Magic Art brush and special no-mess paper. Great for ages 3 and up — and it pairs with the 50-sheet refill pack for marathon little artists.

title: Thoson Bot - Full Pack™
body_html:
A little robot that turns "I can't draw" into "look what I made." Thoson Bot guides kids step by step with a clear, real voice while it draws alongside them — a screen-free kit that blends drawing, early robotics and hands-on STEM play.

Kids pick a card, load it, and follow along as the Bot brings each drawing to life, building fine motor control and creative confidence with every picture. No apps, no tablets — just making things.

The Full Pack includes the Thoson Bot, 100 drawing cards and its washable marker set. Recommended for ages 3 and up.
